verdict.rationale: There is no documented auto-shutdown timer or explicit spend-limit setting for Pods. Runpod's prepaid, credit-based billing implicitly caps spend at the account balance, and Serverless Flex workers scale to zero when idle. Optional auto-pay reloads the balance automatically, which removes that implicit cap, and Pods otherwise appear to be stopped manually via console or CLI. Missing for 10: Pod idle/auto-shutdown timers, configurable spend limits or budget alerts, and hands-on corroboration of cost protection.
